englishText: The Lab Directory tells you what kinds of resources you can extract from a processing station, like an extractor, sifter or centrifuge. Place it near a processing station, and it'll show you things you can put in, and things you can get out. It can be pretty handy at times.

^orange;Upgrade Modules^reset; are super valuable things. You can spend them to upgrade your weapons and armor on your ^orange;Personal Tricorder^reset;. They can also be used to increase the size of your ship, unless you prefer to build your own.
^orange;Tech Cards^reset; are used to create new tech abilities that will help with your mobility. There are all kinds of tech that you can make on your ^orange;Tricorder^reset;'s Tech Craft menu.
A ^orange;mining laser^reset; is less precise than your Manipulator, but it can cut through the earth like it's butter, especially if you upgrade it on your ^orange;Tricorder^reset;.
A ^orange;repair gun^reset; lets you repair your mech while it's on the field. With some Manipulator Modules, you can upgrade it using your ^orange;Tricorder^reset;, to make it much more effective.
What an odd thing that is. I'm not sure what it does, or how old it is. Hopefully, putting it under a ^orange;microscope^reset; could tell us something about it.
This ^orange;fungal ichor^reset; is very sticky on any organic matter. It's got a bunch of applications; usually, the most reliable way to get it is as a byproduct of certain alien herbs.
^orange;Ammonium sulfate^reset; is the key ingredient to all your agricultural utilities, such as fertilizers, pesticides, and live explosives.
You got some ^orange;fertilizer^reset;! If you have any plants in growing trays, they will just love this stuff.
You got bamboo! It's, uh... You can, uh... You can build with it.
This... thing is a ^orange;Blister Sack^reset;. Its only known use is for making disgusting equipment no one would reasonably want. Great.
This wretched glob of ^orange;putrid slime^reset; is allegedly useful for a fair few things. Cool, I guess...
Calcium nitrate is a chemical useful for making pesticides. It could also be pretty useful for synthesizing new kinds of plants.
^orange;Circuit boards^reset; are neat. At the moment, I live in one! These are the ingredient to a lot of advanced machinery.
Hmm. These are just random ^orange;spare parts^reset;. There's no way we're gonna find anything they're meant to fit. We could extract them and get some tungsten out of it.
^orange;Hydrogen^reset; is a useful gas; you can use it in agriculture to make seeds, or use it in chemistry, to make graphene among other things. It's generally just nice stuff to have.
^orange;Nitrogen^reset; is a handy gas to have. It's got uses in just about every field of science.
^orange;Oxygen^reset; is perhaps the most famous gas ever, 'cause we're breathing it every second of our lives. It has some pretty neat applications in making things.
^orange;Salt^reset;, the fabled sodium chloride! It's useful for biofuel, pesticides, fertilizers, plastics, and a bunch of other things, like making food tasty.

This ^orange;genetic material^reset; is very important for a successful laboratory! I know this because absolutely nothing in the Frackin' Universe files uses this radio message, indicating it was removed from the game for simply being too useful!
^orange;Iodine^reset; will be a necessity for a variety of botanical wizardry. It's also great for making methyl iodide. I don't know what that is, but we can figure it out later.
^orange;Magnesium powder^reset; is used for creating cell matter and unstable particles, the latter of which you can use to make energy cores.
^orange;Magnesium sulfate^reset; is mostly just used to make really good fertilizers. It's also apparently used in... drugs, or something, I don't know, really.

We can use ^orange;methyl iodide^reset; to make pesticides, as well as fertilizers. It's apparently abbreviated sometimes as "MeI", which sounds like "me-eye", so... I find that funny. Miyai. Sounds like a greeting.

^orange;Mineral samples^reset; are quite useful in creating new plants! In fact, they're so useful that I am going to not tell you what kind of mineral it is, so that way you can just find out as a surprise.
^orange;Mutavisk silk^reset; is an alien type of silk produced by mutavisk plants. It's stronger than regular silk, and it insulates against radiation.
^orange;Bio Thread^reset; is mutavisk woven into a usable form. It's usually used to make mutavisk bandages, though it's also applicable for making armor and stuff.

These radio messages are so fucking stupid. They're like "This stuff is an absolute staple in all aspects of your lab work that you're totally going to be doing because I have hereforth decided you're a scientist for some fucking reason!" And then you look at the item and it's some vague shit like "Metallic Substance" and it's completely removed from the entire fucking game.
^orange;Pesticide^reset; kills off any bugs that try to eat the crops in your growing trays, which can help them grow faster. It's also an ingredient for better fertilizers.
That's a ^orange;dinosaur egg^reset;! I pray its mother does not know we're messing with it.
Apparently this is one of the generic materials you used to get when extracting stuff. That explains the vague name... I guess? Anyway, it's not in the mod anymore, so whatever.

^orange;Bones^reset;, surprisingly, can be used to make some really basic weapons; if you were to research ^orange;Armor and Weapons^reset;, you could make some using your ^green;crafting menu^reset;.
^orange;Leather^reset; is always useful to have for making clothes, upholstery and such. You can research ^orange;Craftsmanship^reset; for some ways to use it.
^orange;Silk^reset; is a particularly comfy kind of fiber, the go-to for fancy clothes. It's also, of course, really useful for making armor. It's an ingredient in plastic, too.
I guess you could find some applications for ^orange;slime blobs^reset;, if you want...
This ^orange;endomorphic jelly^reset; is some kind of... stuff. I... think you could try making it into... something? Probably more random armor or whatever.
What a weird little thing. A ^orange;strange nodule^reset; like this is full of unusual, alien genes; you could probably make some interesting biology experiments out of it.
^orange;Shoggoth flesh^reset;? No. I can't look. I have no idea what we could possibly want to hold onto this for. Keep it away from me!
^orange;Methanol^reset; is a versatile type of alcohol you can use to make a variety of things. If you need some at any time, it's easy to get if you extract some wood.
^orange;Helium-3^reset; could be usable as fuel in a fusion reactor. It's an ingredient of power cores, too.
^orange;Caliginous gas^reset; like this is a dangerous toxin that will definitely spell the end of your lungs, if you were to breathe it in...
This is ^orange;corvex^reset;. I don't know what it is, but it can do some weird, weird stuff, that you wouldn't expect anything to scientifically be able to even do.
If you extract ^orange;koanite^reset;, it's a good source of phosphorus and calcium nitrate, as well as nitrogen, if you end up needing any of those.
These ^orange;bioluminescent spores^reset; ought to be useful in some kind of biology thing, I'm sure. Can't go wrong with alien fungus.
^orange;Algae^reset; can be made into biofuel, the fuel of the future. You can research ^orange;Chemistry^reset; to find out how to make biofuel, if you're interested.

^orange;Advanced plastic^reset; is used to make all kinds of things. If you need a supply of silk to make it, you can harvest it from bracken trees; you can see if you can learn how to make those if you research ^orange;Agriculture^reset;.

^orange;Silicon^reset; is genuinely vital stuff to have. You use it to make circuit boards, and those are in everything! Extracting sand is a great source of it, of course, but smelting certain types of rock will also get you lots of it.

englishText: Oh, thank goodness you actually found me! I've been stuck in this chunk of space rock for I don't even know how long.
...And NO ONE heard my distress calls! They'll be sorry they missed out on the smartest digital Neki in the Sol system!

Um... my name is Chay, by the way. I'm a part of my own SAIL kernel, the Non-Essential Kitty Interface - or, you know, NEKI for short. I digitized myself into this computer, and then I couldn't get myself out...
Hey, look: I know how we can get out of here - and I in particular really want out of here. Could you take my SAIL chip out of this computer?
Take me out of here, and you can plug me into your ship. Now let's move! The atmosphere in this place is getting thinner by the second, and only one of us here can currently live without air.

You don't need to worry about a crew, now. Your ship's in safe hands with me. If I were you, I'd love having a spaceship to myself! But, hey, if you wanna recruit some people to help out, it's your call; just please make sure they know what they're doing...
You have no inactive crew members right now. Crew members become inactive if you exceed the amount of active crew members your ship can support.
Um, I'm not sure what this menu's for. Missions? What missions? We're kinda just trying to survive out here right now. Wherever 'here' is.

^#6f6f6f;$ status 
^cyan;>Um. Hi. Can you reboot the ship?
Yeah, our ship's not lookin' pretty right now. You oughta ^green;beam down and have a look around on the planet we're orbiting. ^cyan;I pray we can find something to fix this mess.

Happy to report our ship can at least fly! 
>Thrusters are good to go. 
>The ship teleporter is working. 
>^green;You can travel anywhere in this system, ^cyan;but we can't go interstellar till we fix the FTL drive.

Hello again! The ship's in fine shape as usual. 
>Thrusters are good to go. 
>FTL drive is good to go. 
>The ship teleporter is working. 
>You can go just about ^green;anywhere in the universe!
Oh. Oh, you're eating yourself? Alright, cool. That's fine. I was considering jumping ship anyway.
...What is this thing? It's like, some kind of stone, that's alive. I have absolutely no records of anything resembling it. I really have no idea what to say.

You know, I have to say, I'm glad I'm an AI right now, because otherwise I would get nightmares having been in the mere presence of whatever unholy incarnation of a crafting table you just acquired. I would SERIOUSLY watch it around that thing.
I'm picking up biological signatures. Stand by while I ^red;****^reset;...oh dear. The weather is interfering with our connection. If I can no longer reach you, NEKI can guide you.

That is deuterium. You'll find it if you sift through the soils of a proto world, but with some ^green;chemistry^reset;, you could also synthesize it. If you plan on working with unstable particles, you'll need this stuff.
Tritium is made as a byproduct of nuclear fission. It's useful for making a handful of things; or, you can use it as fuel, or extract it to get some helium.
Plutonium's a nice fuel source on its own, but enriched plutonium is even better! By quite a big margin, I should add!
Enriched uranium is so radioactive, it glows even greener than I do. This stuff can actually be used to make ^orange;armor-piercing rounds^reset;, you know that?
Sweet neptunium. It's a step above uranium in radioactivity, and it's pretty useful stuff. You can even use it to synthesize deuterium, which could come in handy.
Thorium! That stuff's a little rare, you know. But it's useful for lots of little different things. Make sure to dig it up if you see any, 'cause you might need it.
Whatever this stuff is, it's the most radioactive thing I've ever seen. We'll catalog it as "ultronium", because that sounds appropriately cool.
Is that neutronium?! What compelled you to collect every possible radioactive isotope to the point where you made a hypothetical one into reality?!
The destructive potential of anti-neutronium is mind-boggling. DO ^red;NOT^reset; play with this stuff. Don't even look at it funny.

englishText: This alien compound has got some weird elements in its genetic code that I can't identify. You could probably use this to make some pretty wild stuff.
Whoa, there, hold on. Lasombrium seeds? This stuff is, like, MADE of evil. You might want to wash your hands after handling it.
What the hell?! Morphite?! Did you just create a new element?!
Ooh, mulch. That stuff's nice to have as a basic fertilizer. It's better than nothing.
Fascinating jar of goo you've got there. Looks like it's very mutagenic. I'd wear gloves around that stuff if I were you.
There are some kooky things goin' on in this stuff. The heck are you gonna use it for?
Oh, another new mutagen. That stuff looks deadly. I guess the scent would make a nice candle, though...?
Alright, WHAT are you doing with this stuff? I've never seen such a strange jar of hostile mutagenic goo in my life.
We are doing some SERIOUS science now. The unstable particles you're holding have some pretty exotic uses for machines and equipment.

englishText: This Hazard Lab Table will let you make protective equipment for exploring hostile environments, like augments, EPPs, consumables, and regulators.
You got an enhancement pack! They'll give you a variety of boosts to your abilities. You can improve them with augments, too.
The regulator you've just picked up can be placed to block the surrounding area from being affected by deadly planetary hazards.
^reset;The conditions we're in right now are survivable, but you're going to need to be careful. Hazards like these are going to endanger us a lot; either from weather, or the planet's atmosphere.
When you get the chance, you should see if you can put together a ^orange;Hazard Lab Table^reset;. You'll be able to make protective equipment there.
The conditions on this planet are too dangerous to explore! ^green;Even if you have ^orange;protective gear^green;, it'll only help a little!
You'll need to ^orange;upgrade your Hazard Lab Table^reset; to make ^green;strong enough gear to protect against this fully.

FTL travel will cost ^green;%s fuel^reset;.
Ready to roll?
Plutonium's a nice fuel source on its own, but enriched plutonium is even better! By quite a big margin, I should add!
Liquid spookium for your FTL drive can be mined from moons. It should be noted that since Earth's destruction, all moons scanned have delivered strange, unpleasant, and spooky readings.
suggestedKorean: 오오, 음식이다! 나도 먹을 수 있으면 좋겠어. 하지만 난 에너지만 필요해. 좀 지루하지 않아? 그리고 배가 부르면 몸이 스스로 치유할 수 있어. 하지만 살찌지 마!

englishText: The ship's FTL drive runs on spookium, which is found on moons. I'm... not sure why, but since Earth was destroyed, there have been anomalous readings coming from almost every moon in the galaxy...
Oooh, food! I wish I could eat. But all I need is energy. Kinda boring if you ask me. Also, with a full belly your body can heal itself. But don't get fat!
PLEASE eat some food! You're starving! To death, in particular!
Back to basics, I see! Ah, who would'a thought we'd spend our first day on the job cutting trees?
The wood you're collecting is useful for a lot of stuff we're gonna be needing. Take a look at your crafting menu when you get the chance.
Got some seeds, huh? If you make a Foraging Table, you can make tools that'll allow you to plant those seeds and start a farm!
With a campfire, you can cook some basic food. Until we get you to a kitchen, you'll have to make do with skewered alien meat and boiled rice, I guess...
You got coal! Plunk a little chunk of that stuff onto a piece of wood, and that'll give you a torch. As you know. As... everyone knows, actually.
Ooh, a bow? You, my friend, are on your way to some fresh meat! Make sure to time your shots right!
I'm detecting a whole zoo of creatures down there, so if you want to search it for Core Fragments, you might want to gather some iron to make some equipment for yourself before you do.
What? When has that ever happened before? How am I suppose to know which thing you're referencing among the thousands of years of media we've accumulated?
It wouldn't be funny if I told you!
I feel like there has to be some kind of karmic retribution for us doing this.
What, you can't handle a bit of cold?
Do NOT use this oil to cook things with, if anyone asks you to.
An EPP allows you to survive in places that have no air, like on moons or underwater! Other models protect you from heat and cold and stuff! You can also power it up with an augment.
If you wanna see a pin-up of ME, you're gonna have to do a lot more than just buying it at the store!
No you don't. Just go to Tux's Newgrounds page and filter the art gallery to M-rated.
Pleeeeease eat something... Gosh, you haven't had food in ages!

While I'm stuck as a little computer in your head, I can refer to SAIL's entire database, and I can teach you to craft almost anything imaginable, step by step! You should start by making an ^orange;inventor's table^reset;.
The inventor's table you've crafted lets you build other stations to craft stuff at! Good of you to invest in carpentry.
That flag you've got there can be set as a bookmark for your teleporter. You can warp back to it from hundreds of light years away!
What are you doing, digging up ore in this day and age? What'cha gonna do, smelt 'em into bars and use 'em to make equipment? Is this the Bronze Age? Look at you go.
Hey, core fragments! These things are packed with energy. Twenty of these, and that'll be enough for all we need 'em for.
Plant fiber is gonna be useful for you in particular, for making clothes and armor. You can also weave it into rope, and make it into salve.
Got some dye, huh? If you hold your color up to a piece of clothing, you can dye it with a ^#71f2f6;right click^reset;.
Environmental Protection Packs give you immunities to tons of different atmospheric hazards! With that thing on your back, now the only place you CAN'T go is a gas giant!
Augments can power up Environmental Protection Packs with abilities like extra energy, health or damage. You can equip it by right-clicking it onto your EPP. Unimaginable power!
So, if you put that collar there on a captured monster, it'll boost their abilities and make them stronger. That, or it can make them explode. Explode with intent, of course.
In this Capture Pod, you can fit a whole dang living being. There's lots of different aliens across the stars to capture! You can throw it at one once it's weakened in order to catch 'em and tame it.
You can also use throwable hunting spears to carve meat from monsters. They're slow, and heavy, but they're powerful.
Manipulator Modules are used to upgrade Matter Manipulators, and that includes yours! With enough of these, you can give your Manipulator extra modes, range, and mining power!
...Y'know, that thing mines so slowly, I'm convinced it was just supposed to be a graduation prop.
If you want to take the long way down, you might run into less trouble - and more ore - if you dig your own mine, deep enough to mine the Core Fragments yourself.
Well, isn't that something? This ancient door looks like it leads to a pocket dimension containing some kind of trial. If you wanna hop in, we can find out...
I'm detecting a whole zoo of creatures down there, so if you want to have a look inside, you might want to gather some iron to make some equipment for yourself before you do.
Manipulator Modules are used to upgrade tools - mainly, your ^orange;Matter Manipulator^reset; - but using your ^orange;Tricorder^reset;, you can also upgrade certain kinds of equipment with them.
A lot of upgradeable tools are made at a ^orange;Tinkering Table^reset;, like mining lasers, repair guns, hookshots, parasols, and cave scanners. They can get powerful, if you invest in them.

You've got an upgrade from your regular Matter Manipulator. You can install it using by pressing ^green;Shift + secondary fire^reset; on your ^orange;Tricorder^reset; and placing it in your Manipulator slot.
This Toymaker's Table lets you make all kinds of festive items, enough to build Santa a brand new workshop!
Uh oh, a heart forge? Someone in particular you've got in mind?
I'm kinda tired too, y'know... Doing all this... stuff is... tiring...

Oh, I love shepherd's pie! It's my favorite! All those hearty, delicious meats and vegetables were the only thing that could keep my belly full when I was a cadet. My crewmate... well, all ^pink;she^reset; ate was sawdust.
Alright, don't you go shooting any holes in the surfaces of any worlds now. I'm sure you know what comes with great power.
Can't have a brick battle without a paint gun! See if you can get some dodge-balls n' sling shots up in here too. It'll be just like old times.
WOW-WHEE, I bet you're glad I told you to grab that thing on your graduation day! Look at it now!
Oh, come on. You want me to bookmark this? You wanna warp to... underwear from anywhere in the universe? You gotta be fffucking kidding me.
Okay, look, like, there's a point where it stops being sexy and it just basically becomes diet nudity, okay? It's not even fashionable at this point.
I mean, really do think about that, yeah? How much stylistic charm can you fit into a few strings and straps, compared to my stylin' jacket and fancy red skirt?
I'm not above bikinis or anything. I just like them to have aesthetic.
Um... Are you, uh... sure that's gonna... protect you from anything...?
Well, I guess it's on me for giving you the Neki armor blueprints, of all things.
You kiddin' me? You could literally SWIM in this armor! As in, go to the beach with it and no one would bat an eye!
Well, maybe no one would think it's weird, exactly, but they'd sure be checking you out.
Uh oh. You just ate raw meat! You know, you're not really supposed to... um...
...Oh, it looks like your body can accept that just fine, I guess? Your life signs aren't showing anything weird, so I guess your biology can accept raw meat. Carry on with that, I suppose.
Oh, brother. Did no one tell you that you can't have chocolate or coffee? They're poison to you! You had better get some medicine.
^red;(SHE IS TRYING VERY HARD NOT TO SING THE SONG)
^orange;Welcome^reset; to my Mobile Lab, traveller! Come on in and visit! I've got a big comfy couch and a medical bay if you have any nasty injuries to heal up!
In order to fix your ship you'll need to complete ^orange;several tasks^reset;. ^green;Speak to me^reset; to begin.

Good news; believe it or not, someone actually lives on this planet. There are ^orange;signals coming from some kind of nearby laboratory^reset;. I guess ^orange;we ought to go give it a look^reset;, unless you want to carry on with our interstellar camping trip.
Those core fragments powered up the gate... but now, there's a ^orange;message^reset; coming through it.

Would you happen to know about any ^orange;archaic energy sources^reset; on this planet? I've detected one nearby. ^green;We can check it out^reset;... or, we can just carry on with our interstellar camping trip, if you want.
Well, would you look at that? It looks like there's actually some kind of ^orange;radio broadcast coming through this thing^reset;. Give it a listen.
...Interesting. Well, the good news is, the geo-scans say ^orange;there are Core Fragments on this planet^reset;. The bad news is that they're pretty far down, at the center of the world.
Great, you've gotten this gate working! The radio signals coming out of it are stronger now. It sounds like another ^orange;message^reset;.

englishText: Hey, sweet. A tech binding station, huh? This can let you create tech cards which you can use to equip techs anywhere you go.
If the Tech Development Console doesn't recognize your tech drives, you can fix the issue if you ^orange;format the tech drive by putting it in a Refinery^reset;.

If you need a copy of a tech to use in the Tech Development Console, you can ^green;select a tech in your ^orange;tech equip menu^green; and press the "download" button^reset;. This'll cost you one tech card.
If you end up with a spare downloaded tech card you don't need, you can put it in a ^orange;Refinery^reset; to get the blank tech card back.
A lectern like this one can hold codexes for your reading convenience. It'll also keep everything it has on it, even if you relocate it.
That's a blank book! You can write anything you want in it. I can also see everything you write, so watch your mouth.
With paint, you can paint. Paint blocks. You can't paint pictures. And neither can I.
You've got a ladder now. You can climb it by standing in front of it and ^#71f2f6;holding down the spacebar^reset;.
Hey, you got a music sheet! You can play the songs you find at a radio, and you can make that at a Tool Table.

Got yourself a proper mining tool now, huh? You can put it in any of your item slots and use it like normal, but you can also put it in your Matter Manipulator slot using the right-hand toolbar, if you want.
You've unlocked the tech ^green;%s^reset; You can purchase it at a tech console by using tech cards.
You've unlocked the techs ^green;%s^reset; You can purchase them at a tech console by using tech cards.
Your nervous system is working incorrectly! How embarrassing :3 You should take your nervous system out of your body so you can fix it.

englishText: ^orange;Pristal shards^reset; are a crystal-metal hybrid that can be forged into ^orange;prisilite^reset;, which you can then make into some very shiny equipment. It's also one of the three components of tritanium alloy, so be sure to pick some up for that, if nothing else.
^orange;Telebrium^reset; is a crystal almost always found on moons, alongside erchius. It can conduct energy, but it's also strong against concussive force, so it's pretty versatile.

^orange;Lead^reset; poisoning is about the most mundane danger you'll be facing while you explore space - assuming you're a carbon lifeform, anyway - but do still be aware of it. Despite that, lead's super useful, especially for alloys, so do pick some up.
This is ^orange;irradium^reset;, and it makes your Geiger counter sing like an Avian! Its radioactivity can be made dormant, and it can then be made into some dangerous equipment, or strong alloys.

Among the many weird minerals of the universe, ^orange;sivite^reset; is surprisingly NOT one of the kinds you can make into wacky armor and weapons you won't ever get around to using. Rather, it's a nice source of magnesium powder and phosphorus if you extract it.
^orange;Protocite^reset; is only found on Proto Worlds. You can liquify it to power stuff, make it into alloys, or most importantly, make quantum computer chips from it.
That's pure ^orange;carbon^reset;. You can make it into carbon plating, or graphene, which are both great to have. Make sure to stock up on it if you can.

^orange;Cinnabar^reset; is a great source of mercury, if you extract it. This stuff, especially. It's actually very rare for it to be this pure! On Earth, anyway. The geology of the crazy planets we've been visiting might be a different case.
What you've just picked up is called ^orange;lasombrium^reset;, and it is a really creepy metal that phases in and out of reality, apparently. That is all the data I have on it.
That's ^orange;densinium^reset;! It is the toughest metal known to all of science, and it even glows purple, like the mythical, legendary ore it is. So cool...
^orange;Graphene^reset; is lovely stuff to have. It's used mostly as a capacitor to make advanced circuits, but it's also a great material to make equipment with.
^orange;Sulphur^reset; is useful for making fertilizers. It can also be extracted to get sulphuric acid, which is necessary for making batteries.
^orange;Magnesite^reset; is a great source of magnesium, if you smelt it or extract it. Magnesium is good to have for a fair few things, mostly involving biology.
^orange;Mascagnite^reset; is a good source of ammonium sulfate, if you extract it. 'Course, there's about a dozen other different ways to get it too...

That's ^orange;penumbrite^reset;, which is only found in penumbral biomes. Refine this stuff into shards, and you can craft some sleek equipment that looks the cool kind of alien. It's also useful for alloys, too.
^orange;Quietus^reset; is... well, it's, um, alive, kind of? I don't know, man. I guess you can still make it into stuff, but... Eugh...
^orange;Lunari^reset; is a particularly shiny breed of crystal. This stuff is everywhere on crystalline planets. If you refine it, you can make it into stuff just like you would a metal.
^orange;Zerchesium^reset; has an impressive melting point, so turn up the heat on your furnace if you plan to smelt it. You can use it to make advanced alloys, or a number of other neat things.

englishText: Hey, you there! ^#71f2f6;Press A or D to get up^white;. You're gonna be okay, but you've got to get moving.
To interact with objects, doors or people, ^#71f2f6;hover your cursor over them and press E^white;.
There's a Protectorate uniform in that locker. You should put it on, in case you get caught here.
Well, I'm not sure what you did to get yourself here, but fortunately, your ship is still in one piece. It's sitting on the roof of the complex, so let's go find it!
Get yourself a weapon from that chest. I'm detecting some hostiles in the rooms ahead, probably from the thing that destroyed Earth.
Damn it. The way to your ship is blocked by all this rubble. We gotta find a way to clear it...
I know! Try the storage area downstairs. There are two keypads to unlock it; they should be around here somewhere.
This is a ^#71f2f6;Matter Manipulator^white;! It's a tool that can deconstruct matter. We can use it to clear out the rubble blocking us from getting to your ship.
Normally, the biometric locks would stop you from using it if you weren't a Protector. I, however, have recalibrated it using my techno-magic to allow you to wield it. You're gonna thank me for this.
Okay, now use the Manipulator to clear out this rubble! You can ^#71f2f6;equip it with the R key^white;, then just ^#71f2f6;click and hold the left mouse button^white; to use it.
The power is out in this area, so this door isn't going to open. Try ^#71f2f6;using spacebar to jump^white; into the vent above us and use that to get through.
Before we go, there's a sword in that chest you should pick up. It might be in poor condition, but... it does look cool!
Hey, look, the Protectorate makes REALLY good swords, okay? I'd highly recommend taking it from that chest. I'm sure we can find someone to repair it.
Okay, let's get out of here. I don't know how long your ship can take us in this condition, but it'll have to work for now.
It looks like whoever worked here was searching for a cult. I don't suppose they would have anything to do with what happened here...

englishText: At this station, they manufacture general electronic parts used for a big range of space-age tech.
An extraplanetary culinary stronghold! This station produces food and ingredients for all kinds of species and cultures.
A medical space station, where scientists develop medicine for everything, to take the pain away!
Cutting-edge weapon parts are manufactured at this station, to help fight the many dangers of space.
This dinky little space rock is being used as a headquarters for the Terrene Peacekeepers.
A musty old office building, concerningly floating in space, refitted into a hub for the Peacekeepers.
A dedicated space station for the Terrene Peacekeepers. Slightly rusty, but it's functional.
A fine looking space station, used as a headquarters for the Terrene Peacekeepers.
A bustling, sleek space station, proudly used as a hub for the Terrene Peacekeepers.
A whole independent space station, the sole responsibility of whoever deployed it! They better be keeping it in shape...
Everything about this ship signals to me that I don't expect you'll be meeting anyone nice there.
Everything about this ship signals to me that I don't expect you'll be meeting anyone nice there.
A small ship, sailing through the stars. Its crew sends word that they're open for visitors, if you wanna check it out.
A small ship, sailing through the stars. Its crew sends word that they're open for visitors, if you wanna check it out.
A small ship, sailing through the stars. Its crew sends word that they're open for visitors, if you wanna check it out.
A small ship, sailing through the stars. Its crew sends word that they're open for visitors, if you wanna check it out.
There's something out here, in the middle of the void. The scans aren't saying much.
A refuge for outlaws who are smart enough to realize the best place to evade law enforcement is the middle of super nowhere, AKA deep space!
A ship of those who chose to be bound to the stars rather than the law. Not for much longer, I imagine.
A small ship, sailing through the stars. Its crew sends word that they're open for visitors, if you wanna check it out.
An Avali spacecraft belonging to the AEF. Visitors are more or less welcome.
A Saturnian ship from the Solalei country, out to ship goods to other cities across the cosmos. Communications indicate visitors are welcome.
A Saturnian Waspmim ship making a beeline for its next destination. Her captain has buzzed us in. I'm so tired.
This unusual-looking Saturnian ship from the Solalei country voyages through space to trade with other cities. Communications indicate visitors are welcome.
A ship of rebel Angels searching the galaxy to hunt down Ruined Angels. Their communications welcome us to visit.
An Avian Stargazer pyramid floating in space. It's full of murderous zealots.
A Hylotl castle floating in space, full of hostile warriors. Maybe they still think they're at war with the Floran.
A Floran space installation for Ixoling husbandry. They don't seem hostile.
A starship fleet belonging to Letheia Corporation. They're armed with extremely powerful weaponry, and will almost definitely shoot to kill.
Some Novakid outlaws have staked a claim on these mineral-rich asteroids. Arguably illegal, but I don't know who cares out here.
A campus of a Glitch school of technowizardry. It amazes me that they still keep up the medieval thing in space.
A large flagship of the Skath fleet. They're on the hunt for something...
A space station dedicated to trading items and goods, as well as accepting investments for benefits.
A space station that produces and sells medical supplies. They also create long-lasting body enhancers.
A military space station, offering weaponry, weapon parts, and job-seeking tough guys with guns.
The largest fast food chain in the galaxy, supposedly. Their burgers are probably whatever.
There's a lot of radiation in the atmosphere here. You'll want some protection soon.
It's frigid out here... Keep yourself warm.
It's really, really hot here... Try not to faint...
There's a lot of electricity in the air. Your energy will protect you, but be careful.
The air here is toxic! You're gonna get sick if you don't protect yourself!
There is a lethal amount of static electricity in the air here! It'll tear through your energy supply - you need protective equipment!
The air here is LETHALLY poisonous! Do NOT explore here without protection!
Okay, let's do this. If you need to get in or out of the mech, ^#FF1493;press E^reset;.
Our mech can sprint if you ^#FF1493;double-tap a directional key like A or D^reset;. It can also crouch, if you ^#FF1493;hold down the S key^reset;.
Our mech also will automatically crouch whenever you enter a tight space, like up here.
^#FF1493;Double-tap the W key^reset; to enter flight mode! The mech defaults to walking mode when gravity is present, but you can still fly.
The ^red;red bar^reset; above your mech is its health. It can take damage from enemies, but also environmental hazards. The ^orange;orange bar^reset; is your fuel, which is spent over time.
We've just entered a zero-gravity environment. You'll want to keep yourself inside the mech for now, because it's designed to fly through space too.
Enemies in space are harder to hit, because they'll be flying around a lot. You'll need to lead your shots and focus hard on accuracy.
Once you enter an environment that has gravity, the mech will switch to walking mode again. Go ahead and walk through in the mech here.
If you were to ever bust up your mech so bad that you NEED to repair it on the field, you can create an upgradeable ^orange;mech repair tool^reset; at a ^orange;Tinkering Table^reset;.
Watch out for those robots. There are lots of enemies in space, but they WILL drop batteries when defeated, which replenish your health and fuel.
I bet you could even jump on enemies and crush them with the mech's sheer weight. Try jumping on these guys.
Your ^orange;Tricorder^reset; has mech-related tabs you can use to equip or refuel your mech. On the off chance it breaks and tells you "unauthorized user", try restarting this test course.
The ^#FF1493;weird^reset; environment here is damaging your mech! I wish I knew how, but you'd better get out!
The ^#A0522D;high pressure^reset; of this planet is too much for your mech to handle!
Your mech can't protect itself from the ^#9ACD32;proto-poison^reset; in the atmosphere! It's not going to last very long here.
The high ^#6A5ACD;electricity^reset; in this environment is doing a laundry list of bad things to your mech right now!
Your mech's hull is being damaged by the dense ^#32CD32;poison^reset; in the atmosphere. I don't know how that works, but do consider disembarking.
I hate to rain on your parade, but your mech's not powerful enough to handle ^#00FF00;radiation^reset; yet, and there's lots of it on this planet. You might wanna hop out... if you can.

Hey, so, I know it's nice and cozy in here, but... your mech isn't quite resistant to ^#00BFFF;cold^reset; just yet. I think we'd actually be better off on foot right now, if you have some cold protection.
I'm amazed! It's actually so freaking ^#FF4500;hot^reset; on this planet, that it's baking your mech like bread! You probably shouldn't pilot this thing around here just yet.
Liquified galaxies do not play nice with your mech! You better get it out of this stuff!
This liquid protocite is actually restoring your mech's integrity, rather than damaging it. That's neat.
Please remove your mech from the lava. You are not Taro Kitano.
Keep your mech out of this stuff! It's going to wreck every system onboard!
Liquid nitrogen is going to turn your mech into a popsicle! Get out of it!
This acid is eating through your mech's hull!
Essentia obscura is doing things to your mech I can't explain - get out of it now!
I hate to rain on your parade, but your mech's not powerful enough to handle ^green;radiation^reset; yet, and there's lots of it on this planet. You might wanna hop out... if you can.

Hey, so, I know it's nice and cozy in here, but... your mech isn't quite resistant to ^cyan;cold^reset; just yet. I think we'd actually be better off on foot right now, if you have some cold protection.
I'm amazed! It's actually so freaking ^red;hot^reset; on this planet, that it's baking your mech like bread! You probably shouldn't pilot this thing around here just yet.
Please remove your mech from the lava. You are not Taro Kitano.
Alright, spaceman, you're in zero gravity now. Make sure to stay inside that new mech of yours! It's equipped to fly through space, so go ahead and get a feel for it.
When your mech is in an environment with gravity, it'll activate its legs. Go ahead and walk through in the mech here.
The ^#60b8ea;blue bar^white; above your mech is your energy meter, and it'll deplete over time or if you take any damage.
I guess there's still stuff trying to kill us in space, too. Use your mech's weapons to defeat these things, and they'll drop energy batteries that'll replenish your mech's power.
There are some targets out here. Try using your mech's weapon to bust them to pieces!
Looks like you're gonna want to get out of your mech now. ^#71f2f6;Use the E key to exit and enter the mech^white;.
^green;Looks to me like you're all wrapped up here^white;. I guess we can thank the USCM for leaving us this hunk of scrap to build a test course in!
You be careful out there, now. This place looks pretty dangerous, even in a mech.
Whew... ^green;Okay, you made it!^reset; That was ridiculous. You should go back and talk to Dr. Akaggy now.
I'm getting some weird life signatures from this ship. Keep your eyes open, okay?
Looks like we've found a Terrene Protectorate storage complex. I didn't know they had any of these floating around out here.
The ^orange;Ruined^reset; are all over this facility, and they're stronger than the other ones we've encountered. It seems to me like there's Demons around here, too.
Those Angels are taking out the Ruined! We oughta get to the bottom of this before more of them appear.
The Ruined, they're trying to infuse mortal beings with Angel blood! They must be trying to create Nephilim...
There's a Ruined Angel ahead of us that's reading as particularly powerful. Be careful.

> Any ship modifications must be manually done by the captain.

^#6f6f6f;$ status

^#6f6f6f;$ status

^#6f6f6f;$ crew 
^cyan;>You don't need to worry about a crew, now. Your ship's in safe hands with me. If I were you, I'd love having a spaceship to myself! But, hey, if you wanna recruit some people to help out, it's your call; just please make sure they know what they're doing...

^#6f6f6f;$ missions 
^cyan;>Um, I'm not sure what this menu's for. Missions? What missions? We're kinda just trying to survive out here right now. Wherever 'here' is.

^#6f6f6f;$ status 
^cyan;>Yeah, our ship's not lookin' pretty right now. You oughta ^green;beam down and have a look around on the planet we're orbiting. ^cyan;I pray we can find something to fix this mess.

I am detecting entities attracted by the moon's spookium deposits. Their interest in you will grow as you collect more fuel. I would define these entities as 'intractably spooky'.
suggestedKorean: 나는 달의 스푸키움 매장량에 끌리는 존재들을 감지하고 있어. 네가 연료를 더 많이 수집할수록 그들의 관심은 커질 거야. 나는 이 존재들을 '다루기 힘든 유령'이라고 정의할 수 있어.

englishText: In this room you can try out various techs that help you with your mobility. Like double jumping! Or dashing!
You're forgetting something important about your lungs: THEY. NEED. OXYGEN! Get a breathing EPP or you're going to suffocate!
H-h-hold o-on! This planet is V-VERY, VERY, VERY COLD! We need t-to get some protection, or we're going to f-fr-reeze to death!
GAAAHHH!!! IT IS WAY TOO HOT HERE!!! We're going to fry to a crisp in seconds if you don't put on any protection from the heat!!!
This gate looks almost identical to the other ancient gates we've seen. I know it's gotta lead somewhere, but why'd they plunk it way out here on the edge of the system?
You're forgetting something important about your lungs: THEY. NEED. OXYGEN! Get yourself a source of air or you're going to suffocate!
Oops... I don't know if I told you this, but, an anvil is kind of redundant when you can make an ^orange;Armorworks^reset; instead. Weapons? You can make all that and more!
There may still be SOME things you can only make with an anvil, though, so I guess it wouldn't hurt to keep it around...

Since you've cut yourself some timber, maybe you should try making some weapons. You should be able to cobble together some caveman-grade ordnance with your bare hands. You can try researching wood in your ^orange;Tricorder^reset; to find some other options, too.

You've got yourself a shield. Time your blocks just right, and you can do a ^orange;shield bash^reset; that knocks back your attacker and damages them. Some species also get bonuses for perfectly timed blocks, and you might be one of them!

Your biology can't heal in the same way carbon-based life can, keep in mind. You can heal with your own natural abilities, or ^green;edible isotopes^reset;. If you build a ^orange;Greenhouse^reset;, you can use algae to make ^green;reactive gels^reset; that will heal you too.

^red;Be careful, there are pirates nearby!^reset; We're in the vicinity of a Wrexor Nar raiding ship. These guys are relentless cyborg plunderers, and they do not play nice in the slightest. Stay on your toes, got it?
^red;There's a heat wave coming.^reset; Things are getting real hot already, so you might lose some health, and get hungry faster.
^red;Yeesh, why'd it get cold so quick?^reset; You'd better keep yourself warm!
^red;Hey, watch out! Poisonous clouds!^reset; The wind is blowing lethal toxins in our direction, and you need to get some protection or find shelter as soon as possible!
^red;There's a serious electrical storm brewing!^reset; You might have problems with your energy reserves. Watch out for lightning! Maybe just wait it out?
^red;Radiation storm incoming!^reset; The wind is blowing radioactive clouds in our direction!
^red;It's VERY cold here.^reset; You can survive, but I recommend finding a way to keep yourself warm if you want to explore, especially during the night. And stay outta water!
^red;There's an electric storm going on around us!^reset; It's going to mess with your energy levels, and the lightning is not playing nice! You might want to get underground.
These electric storms are deadly when you're on the surface. If you head underground, you'll be safe from lightning strikes.
You're covered in water during an electrical storm like this?! You're like a walking lightning rod now!
Hey, wait! Wait! ^red;Radioactivity levels on this planet are WAY TOO HIGH FOR YOU!^reset; You need to put on some protective equipment or beam back up!
^red;Whew, it's seriously hot here...^reset; During the day, the heat here's gonna skyrocket. Water will help, or maybe some fire resistance. It should get better at night...
Oh, this is much better. Cool water like this is a blessing in a place this hot...
Not so hot now when you're underground, is it? It should be a lot cooler down here, compared to the surface.
Well, now that the sun's down, the heat here should subside a little. The night's dark, but at least it's a lot cooler.
Oh, boy, the sun's coming up again. It's gonna start getting hotter here real soon.
The afternoon sun here's so blazing hot, I can feel it in my circuits! Once the sun starts setting, it should get a little more merciful...
^red;MAN, it's friggin' hot here, huh?!^reset; The tropical climate here is not playing nice! Physical Resistance ought to help, or water, if you can find some that's cool...
Oh, good, water. This'll cool you off! Now you're sopping wet, though.

Oh, dear. Radioactive winds incoming! Any bright ideas?!

Oh, for goodness' sake. The wind is stirring up poison vapors in the air. That's fantastic.

I CAN FEEL IT when you're covered in F-FREEZING COLD WATER in a place THIS COLD!!! And now ^red;you're going to freeze even faster!!!^reset;
GAAAHHH!!! ^red;IT IS WAY TOO HOT HERE!!!^reset; We're going to fry to a crisp in seconds if you don't put on any protection from the heat!!!
The heat beneath the ground is astounding. It must all be trapped inside the planet. You'd better keep yourself cool.
Hey, just a heads up, but there's kind of no air here. I'm assuming you have a remedy for this?

There's a sulphuric storm incoming! You'd better find shelter, otherwise I hope you have protection against acid!

Whoa. The cosmic energy levels here are increasing very sharply. The sun seems to keep it down during the day, but it looks like it gets worse in the night.
Oh, neat, you've spawned some X'i bulbs. You can use these in crafting. They'll also heal you if you're near them.
Hey, whatever you just ate, your biology doesn't agree with it, sadly. I would get some medicine... and try not to eat it again.
^red;Did you just EAT AN ISOTOPE?!^reset; Are you insane?!
